info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Warehouse Inventory Transfer-v3-spec
info.description: The Manage Warehouse Inventory Transfers API facilitates the efficient transfer of inventory between different warehouse locations. This endpoint allows authorized users to update and synchronize inventory levels, ensuring accurate stock management across the supply chain. Typical consumers include warehouse managers and inventory coordinators who require real-time updates for operational efficiency. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their logistics and optimize inventory flow, ultimately improving service delivery.

put.summary: Transfer inventory items from one location to another.
put.description: This operation allows users to transfer inventory items between different locations. It accepts the necessary details as input, such as the originating location, the destination location, and the items to be transferred. Ensure that the inventory levels are synchronized after the transfer.

requestBody.description: Request body for transferring inventory items between locations. This operation updates the inventory count by moving specified quantities from one location to another.

202.description: Request accepted for processing, the transfer will be completed shortly.
